title: Subtype Robustness Is Not Just Accuracy: Calibration Under Unseen Subtype Shift
abstract: arXiv:2608.00928v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Subtype robustness asks whether a model keeps the correct coarse prediction when test examples come from fine-grained subtypes absent from training but still inside a known coarse category. Prior work studies this almost entirely through accuracy. We ask whether the model also stays calibrated. We present the first systematic study of the question across ImageNet, BREEDS, iNaturalist and CIFAR-100 with five architectures. Calibration breaks down on unseen subtypes, where accuracy drops while confidence barely follows, leaving the model systematically overconfident exactly where it has become less accurate. At matched accuracy loss, generic image corruption causes a much larger drop in confidence, so the effect is not a general consequence of losing accuracy. The model reacts to visible degradation but not to in-taxonomy novelty. Recalibration tuned on seen subtypes narrows the gap but does not close it, and out-of-distribution scores

translated_title: 子类型鲁棒性不仅仅是准确性：在未见子类型转移下的校准问题
translated_abstract: 子类型鲁棒性探讨的是，当测试样本来自训练中未出现但属于已知粗类别的细粒度子类型时，模型是否能保持正确的粗粒度预测。以往研究几乎完全通过准确性来评估这一点。我们则进一步探究模型是否也能保持校准性。我们首次在ImageNet、BREEDS、iNaturalist和CIFAR-100数据集上，使用五种架构对该问题进行了系统性研究。结果显示，在未见子类型上校准性会崩溃，表现为准确性下降而置信度几乎不随之变化，导致模型在准确性降低的地方系统性地过度自信。在匹配的准确性损失下，一般的图像损坏会导致置信度大幅下降，因此这一效应并非准确性损失的一般后果。模型对可见的退化有反应，但对分类学内的新颖性无反应。基于已见子类型调整的重校准虽缩小了差距，但未能完全消除，且分布外评分也无济于事。
tldr: 本研究首次系统揭示了在未见子类型转移下，模型校准性会崩溃，导致过度自信，且该现象独立于一般准确性损失，无法通过基于已见子类型的重校准完全修复。
en_tdlr: This study provides the first systematic evidence that model calibration breaks down under unseen subtype shift, causing systematic overconfidence independent of general accuracy loss, and cannot be fully fixed by recalibration on seen subtypes.
